snippet.title: Hydra - Poseidon's conspiracy Gameplay Trailer | PC / SteamDeck
snippet.description:
Dive into the abyss of Hydra - Poseidon's Conspiracy! Explore a forsaken Nazi bunker on Kanaan Island, face deep-sea horrors, and unravel a cosmic conspiracy. Switch between FPS and TPP, solve puzzles, and fight to survive – with 5 unique endings awaiting.
